# ElaWidgetTools provenance

This directory contains a vendored and modified copy of ElaWidgetTools.

- Upstream: https://github.com/Liniyous/ElaWidgetTools
- Upstream license: MIT
- Baseline commit: `2488f5d4a6bc65154d17aaaa3dc4714ba0ec3aa3`
- Baseline date: 2026-04-09

LeyoChat carries local compatibility and widget additions on top of that
baseline. It is not an unmodified upstream checkout. The original MIT license
and copyright notice are retained in `LICENSE`.

The default bitmap resources used by the vendored copy are generated by
`tools/generate_open_source_assets.py`; they do not contain the upstream demo
character artwork. `Font/ElaAwesome.ttf` is the upstream font file. Its
embedded metadata identifies it as a Fontello-generated font and references
the Open Font License; see the font notice in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
